title: Orbital
author: Samantha Harvey
summary: Six astronauts and cosmonauts aboard the International Space Station circle the Earth sixteen times in a single day. The book watches them, and the planet below, in lyrical detail.
readIf: you want a short, meditative novel with beautiful descriptions and little conventional plot.
skipIf: you want a plot-driven space story, because this is closer to a prose poem.

pairings.reason: Also set in space, but a witty, practical survival story with a clear plot.
Another gentle, observant novel that looks at the world through an unusual perspective.
A short, quiet science-fiction novel about time, memory and a sense of wonder.
